answer: Vouching grove: each verified member may invite at most two newcomers per epoch, and the inviter loses reputation if an invitee is later proven fake, so trust grows like a grove where each branch answers for its shoots. A newcomer must wander through a public waiting period where anyone may challenge the claim before gaining full rights. An honest user needs one trusted friend, but a sybil farmer must recruit or bribe a separate voucher for every pair of fakes, turning free registration into a scarce, traceable social cost, with an umber flag marking challenged accounts until cleared.
